coverage.finding: Reviewed 2026-10-01: The own CarbonX PC/ABS TDS gives measured values and printed-specimen preparation, without named intended uses or finishing methods. Carbon fibre reinforcement does not justify a structural application approval. Reviewed source basis: X-ECOMAX-CarbonX-CF-PC-ABS-TDS-v1-1. This is a gap in the reviewed originals, not public-source exhaustion or universal absence; a concrete new official-source lead can reopen the question.
Canonical identity recorded: Polycarbonate / Acrylonitrile Butadiene Styrene Blend (Carbon fibre) (Polymer Blends, base polymer PC-ABS). Aliases and disputed entries are family entries of their own.
H2C status "Theoretical" is recorded with no document cited behind it.
5 mechanical measurement(s) of this material's own grades. See specimen, direction, moisture, preparation and standard before comparing.
2 thermal measurement(s) of this material's own grades. HDT, Tg and Vicat are not continuous-service ratings.

polymer.basis: Classification and typical values from polymer handbooks and resin data sheets, as compiled for the estimate model (docs/audits/2026-09-15-filtering-estimates-data/physics/). The document cited prints a density inside the range, not its ends. Covestro's ISO datasheet for Bayblend T65 XF (R-COVESTRO-BAYBLEND-T65XF-ISO), a non-reinforced (PC+ABS) blend, prints a density of 1130 kg/m³ (ISO 1183-1) and a water absorption of 0.7 % at saturation in water at 23 °C and 0.2 % at equilibrium at 23 °C / 50 % RH (ISO 62), p. 1.
